newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI STOCKS SLIGHTLY UP AT NOON IN SLUGGISH TRADE.
newsitem.headline: THAI STOCKS SLIGHTLY UP AT NOON IN SLUGGISH TRADE.

text.p: Thai stocks were slightly up at midday as improved sentiment over the IMF deal ran up against profit-taking and concern about regional currencies, broker said.
The composite SET index was up 1.84 points to 634.09 on 1.3 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index gained 0.21 points to 48.07.

"Most investors are still sidelined to see where the market market direction will be," said one broker at Ekachart Finance and Securities. "Foreign interest in local shares remained light, dampened by recent turmoil in regional currencies."
Decliners led gainers 88 to 75 with 65 remained unchanged.

Brokers said some investors were taking short-term profits from early rises on the back of news that the International Monetary Fund and other Asian nations pledged to provide $16 billion financial support for Thailand.
Thai Farmers Bank was trading unchanged at 112 on the most active turnover of 145 million baht.

Major power producer Electricity Generating Plc was up 0.50 to 66.50. The company on Wednesday announced a 128 percent rise in its second-quarter profit to 735 million baht from 321.9 million in the same quarter last year.
